phase_metrics.scope: real physical cohorts; initialization excluded; not an exclusive hardware attribution
real physical cohorts; initialization excluded; not an exclusive hardware attribution

storage_traffic.queue_depth_scope: max across physical owners: outstanding host requests sampled at admission, including the admitted request; not NAND page queues

hbf0.memory: outstanding host requests sampled at admission, including the admitted request; not NAND page queues

storage_traffic.page_utilization_scope: logical payload / sum of per-access page-rounded spans; repeated accesses count again; not unique resident capacity utilization

nand_read_queue_depth.reason: page-level observation is opt-in; host requests are separate

nand_program_queue_depth.reason: page-level observation is opt-in; host writes are separate

storage_traffic.accounting_semantics: host_transfer_bytes is logical host payload; physical_* and pages_read/pages_programmed are NAND media accounting; null means not fully recorded; operation_counts classifies task-owner ledgers, not media operations; service_ns is analytical

dram_traffic.service_time_scope: service_ns sums per-task/owner completion spans, which may overlap; it is neither elapsed wall time nor data-bus busy time. resource_totals contains actual per-resource occupied time and bytes.
dram_traffic.accounting_semantics: resolved analytical burst bytes and controller waits; null means not fully recorded; empty organization_profiles is not evidence of complete geometry reporting; no device accuracy claim

metadata.geometry_basis: explicitly modified NAND organization; reference sources describe the original preset only
metadata.timing_basis: paper 1/3 us read and 100 us program; explicitly supplied local erase/front assumptions
metadata.model_scope: controlled NAND media mechanism; no OCP/FTL/GC or paper-serving reproduction
metadata.parallelism_basis: stack count * 16 actual die resources * published planes/die; never bandwidth-fitted
metadata.bandwidth_basis: Table I aggregate directional ceilings; not a claim of measured sustained throughput
metadata.protocol_basis: generic_nand; the article does not specify OCP
metadata.paper_page_basis: 4 KiB read page is explicit; same program-page unit is a local modeling assumption
metadata.host_granularity_basis: explicit local transfer quantum, distinct from the published 4 KiB media page
metadata.partial_page_basis: explicit local policy; read_modify_write pays NandCore's old-page read, internal transfer and page program; reject disallows partial programs. Neither policy is given in the paper
metadata.paper_read_staging_execution: unsupported: no prefetch/double-buffer SRAM controller in this builder
metadata.paper_intermediate_sram_execution: unsupported: no SRAM lifetime/admission controller in this builder

research_assumptions.basis: Local mechanism control only: 256 pages/block, whole-block covering capacity, 2 ms erase, 100 GB/s per die-channel, one aggregate full-duplex host link, 4096 global combined credits with writes sharing those credits, 4 KiB host-transfer granularity and paid read-modify-write for partial program pages. These are local choices, not parameters sourced from this paper; OCP is not selected.

additional_research_assumptions: one core channel per actual die; stack membership represented by consecutive groups of 16 channels
one aggregate host link; explicit host-transfer granularity; zero fixed front delay
no read cache or host-ack write staging; partial programs use the explicitly selected paid RMW/reject policy
generic direct-address page service; no automatic erases, write-order enforcement or GC
whole-block covering capacity is not a disclosed reserve or overprovisioning ratio

metadata.source_provenance: original JEDEC PDF obtained from a public third-party mirror; not a vendor interpretation
metadata.organization_selection: smallest covering raw capacity; equal capacity prefers 8H, 12H, 16H, 4H
metadata.channel_operation_mode_basis: JESD270-4A section 3.1.2 defines two pseudo-channels per channel; no alternative Legacy mode is defined for this generation
metadata.capacity_basis: binary DRAM address capacity; capacity_bytes is a separate visible budget
metadata.bandwidth_basis: caller aggregate directional Gb/s divided by 8; stack bandwidth is not multiplied again
metadata.data_rate_basis: equivalent per-pin rate derived from aggregate bandwidth and external data width, not measured pin speed
metadata.timing_basis: JEDEC command rules and stated minima; IDD example, legal MR reference selections and unknown vendor timings are separately labelled

source_documents.access_method: public mirror of original protocol PDF

geometry_limitations: linear mixed-radix simulation mapping is not a vendor address mapping
standard organization does not establish the target vendor part or timing
metadata.row_bytes_basis: JESD270-4A Table 4 note 3: row_bytes is the 1KiB effective addressed PC page; the MSB of RA selects half of an open 2KiB page
control_limitations: training, parity/ECC transport, auto-precharge and per-bank refresh are not implemented
address mapping, request scheduling, queue scope, open-page behavior and bandwidth-cap pacing are model policies, not JEDEC scheduling requirements
electrical PHY turnaround offsets and unspecified array timing gates require vendor inputs
metadata.accounting_basis: command bus occupancy, DQ busy time and dependency wait are separate; one full 32B DQ burst is charged once; WR recovery limits PRE and is not a write-completion tail
metadata.directional_cap_basis: independent read/write start pacing; DQ remains half-duplex at physical 2CK per burst; interleaved directions may together exceed either directional cap but never the physical interface
